notes.title: Patch Update 6/12
notes.notes:

Added brand new NPC to Chapter 4. Maybe she will be an important character later...
Increased hotspot sizes for some of the smaller things.

Let me know if you have any issues with this update, thanks!

notes.title: Patch Update 4/10
notes.notes:
Howdy! First bug update is here. The following updates were made (4/10/24):

Fixed issue where some inventory items could be picked up multiple times. (How many of you got the change from the payphone twice? lol)
Increased hotspot sizes for some of the smaller things. 
Added flavor text.
Spelling errors.

Let me know if you have any issues with this update, thanks!

notes.title: Kickstarter is COMING SOON!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! Now that the demo is live I wanted to announce that the kickstarter for Bent Oak Island is coming soon! Please follow it if you are interested in helping the game's development. Link is below:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bentoakisland/bent-oak-island]Kickstarter Link[/url]

I want to be clear, Bent Oak Island will be released no matter what, but funds from the kickstarter campaign will help me pay off the bills I already have for developing the game. And if there is a little extra after that, I plan on adding some really cool stuff that I wouldn't otherwise be able to!

Thanks!
